facts.text: The hotel's setting evokes a chapter in the history of Portugal, with its court parties and aristocratic eccentricities.
facts.excerpt: The Valverde Sintra Palácio de Seteais evokes a chapter in the History of Portugal, of the parties in the courts, of the eccentricities of the aristocracy.

facts.text: Rooms keep the same furniture as in the past.
facts.excerpt: The same furniture as in the past and a singular beauty dressing the walls.

facts.text: Signature Suites are on the first floor of the palace, with views over the swimming pool or the Sintra valley extending to the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.excerpt: Located on the first floor of the Palace, the Signature Suites offer stunning views over the swimming pool or the Sintra valley, extending all the way to the Atlantic Ocean.

facts.text: Some Signature Suites have welcomed guests including Eca de Queiroz and Agatha Christie.
facts.excerpt: Some of these suites have welcomed distinguished guests, including Eça de Queiroz and Agatha Christie.

facts.text: Each Signature Suite has a marble bathroom with a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.
facts.excerpt: Each suite features a spacious marble bathroom equipped with both a separate bathtub and walk-in shower.

facts.text: The Royal Suite's decor is inspired by the 18th and 19th centuries, with Dona Maria-style furniture.
facts.excerpt: Its décor, inspired by the 18th and 19th centuries, is enhanced by Dona Maria-style furniture

facts.text: The Royal Suite has a living room, an open-plan office, a relaxation area and a balcony, with views over the pool and the palace gardens.
facts.excerpt: Featuring a french balcony, a living room, an open-plan office, a relaxation area, and a balcony, this suite offers a spacious and distinguished experience, complemented by views over the pool and the Palace gardens.

facts.text: The hotel offers a staged visit to Pena Palace with actors, centred on the private chambers of Queen Amelia.
facts.excerpt: An intimate and exclusive experience with actors, centered on the private chambers of Queen D. Amélia. A different way to experience Pena.

facts.text: The staged Pena Palace visit is designed for a small group.
facts.excerpt: in a close, immersive format carefully designed for a small group

facts.text: The Pena from Within visit explores the Pena National Palace's architecture, symbolism and landscape at a slower pace.
facts.excerpt: Designed for those who wish to go beyond the essential route, this visit offers a deeper understanding of the Pena National Palace—its architecture, lived experiences, symbolism, and landscape—at a slower pace

facts.text: Afternoon tea is served at five o'clock, with menus paying tribute to Catherine of Braganza and Carlota Joaquina.
facts.excerpt: At five o'clock, tea is served. Catherine of Braganza (1638-1705) introduced the habit to the British court. Carlota Joaquina (1775-1830) was regent of the kingdom of Portugal in troubled times. The menus

facts.text: The hotel offers an outdoor picnic, charged per person.
facts.excerpt:
In the shade of the seasons, the towel is spread. The outdoor table waiting for conversations and laughter. Delicacies and stories are snacked. Here's to love and friendship.
145€ \| per person

facts.text: The Ultimate Dining Experience is a tailored meal for two set in special corners of the palace.
facts.excerpt: A table for two in the most special corners of the palace. A meal tailored to perfection.

facts.text: The restaurant and bar serve recipes from Portugal and the world.
facts.excerpt: These are recipes from Portugal and the world, where the navigators have been.

facts.text: The hotel has a pool and garden.
facts.excerpt: Pool and Garden

facts.text: The hotel has a spa.
facts.excerpt: an afternoon at the spa

facts.text: The palace hosts weddings.
facts.excerpt: Weddings

facts.text: Classic Rooms are in the former palace wing, look over the hotel gardens and come with a double bed.
facts.excerpt: Located on the first and second floors of the former Palace wing, the Classic Rooms stand out for their  elegant décor, and views over the hotel gardens. Available with a double bed

facts.text: Deluxe Rooms come with either a double bed or twin beds and a bathroom with either a bathtub or a shower.
facts.excerpt: Available with either a double bed or twin beds, they offer a comfortable setting in harmony with the historic character of the property. They feature a fully equipped bathroom with either a bathtub or a shower

facts.text: A mountain range for the adventurous, a heritage for humanity.
facts.excerpt: A mountain range for the adventurous. A heritage for Humanity.
